text.en:
MALACAÑANG
PRESIDENTIAL DECREE No. 313 October 19, 1973
APPROPRIATING THIRTY MILLION (P30-M) PESOS TO COVER THE THREE HUNDRED
THOUSAND COMMON SHARES AT ONE HUNDRED PESOS A SHARE SUBSCRIBED BY THE
REPUBLIC OF THE PHILIPPINES IN THE AUTHORIZED CAPITAL STOCK OF THE PHILIPPINE
AMANAH BANK
WHEREAS, Presidential Decree No. 264, dated August 2, 1973, has created the Philippine Amanah Bank,
with an authorized capital stock of one hundred million pesos designed "to provide credit, commercial,
development and savings banking facilities at reasonable terms to the people of the primarily Muslim
provinces of Mindanao and Palawan, for the establishment, acquisition, development and expansion of
agricultural, commercial and industrial enterprises."
WHEREAS, out of the authorized capital stock of one hundred million (P100-M) pesos of the Philippine
Amanah Bank, the Republic of the Philippines is bound to subscribe, pursuant to Section 3(a) of Presidential
Decree No. 264, three hundred thousand common shares at one hundred pesos per share, equivalent to
THIRTY MILLION (P30-M) PESOS;
WHEREAS, the stock subscription of the Republic of the Philippines to the three hundred thousand common
shares in the amount of thirty million (P30-M) pesos has not been provided in the current Appropriation
Decree No. 233, which became operative on July 1, 1973;
NOW, THEREFORE, I, FERDINAND E. MARCOS, President of the Philippines, by virtue of the powers in
me vested by the Constitution and pursuant to General Order No. 1, dated September 22, 1972, issued in
pursuance of Proclamation No. 1081, dated 21 September 1972, do hereby decree:
That out of the funds in the National Treasury not otherwise appropriated, the sum of Thirty Million (P30-M)
pesos is hereby appropriated for the purpose herein provided in this Decree.
This Decree shall take effect immediately.
Done in the City of Manila, this 19th day of October, in the year of Our Lord, nineteen hundred and
seventy-three.
